# RUBRIC.md — the standard

**Do not edit this file. Do not ask Claude to improve it.**

You did not write this, and that is the entire point. A model that writes the standard *and*
meets the standard has measured nothing. An external check is what separates evaluation from
theatre.

Five checks. Each one is pass or fail — there is no "mostly". Each has a test a stranger could
apply in under a minute, with no room to be generous.

---

### 1 · Who you are, without scrolling

**Test:** open the page, scroll nothing, cover everything below the fold. Can you say the
person's name and what they do?

Fails if the name is there but the role is not. Fails if the role is a job title with no
content ("Graduate Student", "Professional"). Fails if you have to scroll.

---

### 2 · One sentence a reader could repeat

**Test:** read the page once, close it, and say one sentence about this person to someone else.

Fails if the only sentence you can produce is generic enough to describe forty other people.
"Passionate about AI and technology" is a fail. "Builds data tools for small clinics" is a pass.

---

### 3 · Something you actually made, with an outcome

**Test:** find the projects on the page. For each one, can you say what it *did* — not what it *was*?

**One real project is enough** — you are just starting. Never invent a second one to fill a card.
Fails if a project has a title and a technology list but no result. "Chatbot — Python, OpenAI"
is a fail. "Chatbot that answers intake questions for a dental office; cut phone time by half"
is a pass. A number, a user, a decision, an outcome — anything real.

---

### 4 · Every link works for a stranger who is logged out

**Test:** open a private window. Click every link on the page.

Fails on: a 404, a LinkedIn URL that only resolves while signed in, an email address with a
typo, a GitHub link to a repository that is private, a link that goes to the class site's home
page instead of the intended target.

---

### 5 · Nothing unfinished is visible

**Test:** read every word on the page, including alt text and the browser tab title.

Fails on: `CHANGE-ME`, `Lorem ipsum`, `Your Name Here`, a placeholder image, `[TODO]`, a
duplicated paragraph, the same name spelled two different ways, an empty section heading with
nothing under it.

---

## How the agent must score this

For every item: **pass or fail, plus one sentence of evidence quoting the page.**

A score with no quoted evidence does not count. "Item 2 passes — the page is engaging" is not
a score. "Item 2 passes — the page says 'I build data tools for small clinics', which is
repeatable" is a score.
